decision: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season.
fact: The driver failed to replace the steering wheel after leaving the car.
offence: Breach of Article B1.8.8 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 14 stopped on track, the driver left the car and failed to replace the steering wheel. This is a safety issue to enable marshals to move the car if required.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 14 Failed To Replace The Steering Wheel After Leaving The Car
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
